title: Fluffy
text: Fluffy. I had to send this product back because it was way too big for me to maneuver, particularly when I was sleepy. I’m sure it’s fine product for many people, but it just didn’t work out for me.

product_metadata.title: Royal Therapy Bed Pillows (Gel Microfiber, Body Pillow (Pack of 1))
features: A night's rest becomes a royal luxury in the Royal Therapy Body Pillow. Designed with hoteliers in mind, our Premium 21x54 inches Body Pillow is an elegant, quiet, and plush pillow shaped to wrap around the body for extra comfort.
This pillow is infused with an 1800 fill power white feather-like down that gives our pillows the luxurious and supportive-yet-airy quality.

The Royal Therapy Pillow is crafted from 100% jacquard cotton, beautifully embroidered with an elegant logo and edged in gold cording. For your convenience, both the pillow and cover can be machine washed and dried.

We designed this pillow for the requirement of comfort, utility and quality. The result is a pillow that approximates the softness and down-like feel of a feather bed, without the odor and sharp quills.
This body pillow is unique because each has a small zipper closure that allows you to adjust the amount of filling inside the pillow to the perfect balance of height and firmness.
